name: Taisei Corporation
summary: Taisei Corporation engages in the civil engineering, building construction and development businesses in Japan. The company is involved in regional, urban, ocean, aerospace, and resources development, as well as energy supply, emissions trading, and development of infrastructure; and planning, designing, supervising, construction and installation, holding, lease, transfer, maintenance, management, and operation of roads, railways, harbors, airports, river facilities, water supplies and sewerage, government buildings, waste disposal facilities, parking and other public facilities, and similar facilities.
